name: report_issue
description: Record a concise tool or context defect for later inspection. Use when: public evidence or an interface result is inconsistent or lacks an admissible next step; ordinary task difficulty alone is not an interface defect. Effect: writes a local issue record without changing the world or ending the episode. Returns: success after recording the message. Does not: deliver a human answer, repair a tool or change the official verdict. On error: supply one nonempty message describing the concrete evidence or interface defect.

message.description: Nonempty issue description from current public evidence; does not request human steering or change the task.
